decisive_items: solitary, mobile, 2 cm × 2 cm submucosal mass with ill-defined borders and a smooth mucosal surface
well-defined, hypoechoic lesion in the right cheek region
provisional diagnosis of an ectopic lymph node versus a lipoma was made
response.rationale: The mobile, smooth submucosal mass and well-defined hypoechoic ultrasound appearance are classic for lipoma. Ectopic lymph node is less likely given these features, and severe pain is not specific to either.

rejected.why: The clinical and imaging features (mobile, smooth, well-defined hypoechoic) are more typical of lipoma than an ectopic lymph node, which would be firmer and less mobile.
